authority.title: Developing assets for the PlayStation 1 (PSX) architecture.pdf
authority.interpretation: PSX visual style with modern game runtime correctness; source does not prescribe arbitrary native file reader list

limitations: Vertex clustering is not quadric-error decimation
OBJ material textures are not imported
Reduced GLB loses original textures and named mesh nodes; UI warns explicitly
PLY, text glTF, FBX, DAE, USD are not implemented

rules.target: small textures and estimates; do not impose literal PS1 hardware defects
preserve puppet part identifiers and joint topologies
rules.verification: OBJ group-specific stats and collapse warning

rules.target: preserve vehicle silhouette and independent wheels
rules.verification: vehicle parts show independent loss stats

rules.target: near/far LOD variants with visual acceptance
protect weapon silhouette and attach points
palette, nearest neighbor, baking preserve unified lighting authority
rules.verification: fallback atlas only in initial implementation

rules.target: no mandatory omission of Z-buffer, arbitrary lighting removal or fog regression
rules.verification: use existing modern game rasterizer and weather

metrics: source and result triangles by part
regression.condition: part entirely collapses or loses >92% triangles with sufficient source faces, or falls to <=2 vertices
regression.response: warn and require explicit confirmation for remaining partially collapsed geometry, disable publish when all faces vanish

validation.ciPolicy: only product functionality blocks release; other checks advisory
